VISION & 
MISSION  OF THE 
DEPARTMENT  
 
 
Vision To provide excellent education in 
Information Technology through effective 
teaching and research  environment  in  pursuit  
of  academic   proficiency,  employment   & 
higher  education  with  social  and  ethical 
values. 
Mission   To   provide   high   quality   technical  
education  in  Information  Technology  by 
delivering  the core  instructions  through  world  
class  infrastructure .To  prepare   students   with  
fine  professional   and   intellectual   skills   to 
solve challenging  tasks  in  the  field  of 
Information  Technology .To  train  students  in 
design  and   implement   novel   systems   based  
on education  and  research  with  the  support 
of senior faculty .To inculcate  students  with 
leadership   capabilities ,  integrity ,  ethical    & 
social values .

Department of IT 
 
The department  of Information  Technology  was established  in  the  year  
2007, right from the inception  of the college , with an annual  intake  of 
60 students  for B.Tech programme . At present  (a.y. 2021 - 22), the 
department  intake  for undergraduate  (B.Tech) is 60. There  is  a  lot  of  
demand  for computer  professionals  from the  software  industry ,  at  the  
same time, there is a stress on the quality  of education  and training . This 
has resulted  in modernizing  the  laboratories ,  updating  the  teaching  
learning  process  and exposure  to the latest technologies . 
 
The department  has a mix  of  both  experienced  and  young  faculty . 
Majority of the faculty members are actively involved in improving their  
educational  qualifications  and actively  engaged  in research  activity . The 
faculty  have been attending  various  seminars , workshops  and training  
programs  conducted  by various  other reputed  organizations . 
 
The IT department  has aesthetially  designed  computer  laboratories  
accommodating  732  computer  systems .  All  laboratories  are  air 
conditioned  with a power backup  of  125  KVA  DG  set  to  help 
uninterrupted  functioning  of  the  laboratories .  Licensed  Softwares  like  
MSDN Academic  Alliance  Pack , MS - Office , SUSE LINUX server , Media  kit 
for office software  etc are made available  in the  laboratories .  All  the  
systems  are connected  through  LAN Facility : 10/100 MBPS Network  
Connections .
